name: swipe-delete-row
title: Swipe Delete Row
description: Swipe-to-delete row that deletes only when dragged past a visible line (not on a fast flick or vertical scroll), resists like a rubber band, springs back if released early, has a trash button for keyboard users and keeps an Undo before the delete commits.

meta.summary: Makes swipe-to-delete deliberate: the row deletes only past a visible line, never on a flick or scroll, and keeps an Undo.
catches: Swipes that don't cross the threshold
Fast flicks that cross it too quickly (minSwipeMs)
limits: onDelete runs after the undo window, so the item stays in your data until then
Undo is in-memory; a navigation commits the delete
a11y: Trash button with an aria-label naming the item, for keyboard and switch users
After a keyboard delete, focus moves to Undo; after undo, back to the trash button
Status uses role=status and a polite live region
